name: email-payday-scan
title_zh: 专挑晚上8点到早9点的催债邮件取证员
tagline_zh: 翻遍 Gmail 和 iCloud 收件箱+垃圾箱，只筛近两年催债邮件。
tagline_en: Scans Gmail & iCloud (Inbox+Spam) for debt-collection emails from the last 2 years, flags ones outside 8am-9pm.
desc_en: Scans Gmail and/or iCloud Mail (Inbox and Spam/Junk) for debt-collection and payment-demand language, restricts results to the last 2 years (or since the last run, in scheduled mode), and reports only the matching emails received outside 8am-9pm in the user's own local time as potential FDCPA time-of-day violations, each with an embedded screenshot, stored in a dated Google Sheet. Supports a light
why_zh: 它不靠关键词猜，而是按你本地时区算钟点——垃圾箱里的深夜催债信才是律所最想要的证据。
why_en: It judges by your local clock, not keywords—so spam-folder 2am demands become billable evidence, screenshots embedded so you.
limit_zh: 只认英文债务催收措辞，不覆盖其他骚扰邮件；需已配置 Gmail API 或 iCloud 应用密码。
limit_en: English debt-collection phrases only; needs Gmail API or iCloud app password set up; screenshots need a headed browser; flags timing only, not debt.
